about: NWS alert description texts the river-point parity test runs through scripts/gen-feeds.py river_point() and js/sources.js alertRiverPoint(). The first cases are the KEWX/KAMA/KFWD shapes from 2026-10-02 (also in tests/gen-feeds.test.py); the rest are edge shapes. expect is what both must return.

cases.name: segment WHERE line names its own point, wrapped across two lines
cases.expect: Devils River at Bakers Crossing 19N Of Comstock
cases.description:
...The Flood Warning is extended for the following rivers in Texas...

Devils River At Pafford Crossing nr Comstock affecting Val Verde
County.

Devils River At Bakers Crossing 19N Of Comstock affecting Val Verde
County.

* WHAT...Minor flooding is occurring.

* WHERE...Devils River at Bakers Crossing 19N Of
Comstock.

* WHEN...Until this evening.

cases.name: the other segment of the same product names the other point
cases.expect: Devils River at Pafford Crossing nr Comstock
cases.description:
...The Flood Warning is extended for the following rivers in Texas...

Devils River At Pafford Crossing nr Comstock affecting Val Verde
County.

Devils River At Bakers Crossing 19N Of Comstock affecting Val Verde
County.

* WHAT...Minor flooding is occurring.

* WHERE...Devils River at Pafford Crossing nr Comstock.

* WHEN...Until late tonight.

cases.name: an areal warning's WHERE is a county list, never a river point
cases.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall continues.

* WHERE...Portions of central Texas, including the following
counties, Bosque and Hill.

cases.name: a flash flood warning with no river section
cases.description:
At 806 AM CDT, Doppler radar and automated rain gauges indicated that
heavy rain was falling across the warned area. Up to 4 inches of rain
have fallen.
